response.evidence: Analysis of 1000+ loan applications shows no systematic evidence of discrimination. Approval rates are comparable across racial/ethnic groups (approximately 87-90% approval rate across all groups). Denied applicants show consistently poor financial metrics regardless of race: high debt-to-income ratios (>45%), low incomes relative to loan amounts, or high loan-to-value ratios (>90%). For example, denied applications show average DTI of ~48% vs approved at ~37%. Financial criteria, not applicant demographics, appear to be the primary driver of decisions. However, individual cases require case-by-case analysis with full application details.
